issues.title: bug: Duplicated records in Service Requirements screen
issues.description:
From issue tracker:
> There are at least 5 employee badge/PKI service requirements listed in the Service Requirements view, 2 PSDR, 2 RSS, and possible other duplicates

**Notes**
As noted in the issue tracker item, this affects some Service Requirements entries but not all. For those that it does affect, it appears that a copy of the Service Requirement item is added to the list any time that Service Requirement is clicked on from the screen and opened. 

For example, if you click on the "RSS" item on the Service Requirements screen and then navigate back to the Service Requirements screen, you will see an additional copy of the RSS item. (Same for the others that are exhibiting this behavior.)

This is happening on both TEST and PROD. I have not confirmed if it is affecting all the same items on each. I have not done any research to determine commonalities among the affected items nor differences with the unaffected items.
